title: Passkey-themed social engineering leads to identity and cloud compromise
note: Primary research on active cloud intrusions using passkey/SSO lures, AiTM and device-code flows, attacker-added authentication methods, Graph reconnaissance and cloud data collection.

title: Signing in without actually signing in
note: Okta analyzes infostealer data containing reusable session tokens and API keys, a strong reminder that authenticated state can be stolen and replayed without a fresh sign-in.

title: OpenID Connect Key Binding 1.0 approved as an Implementer's Draft
note: The first Implementer's Draft standardizes binding a public key to an OIDC ID Token using DPoP, an important step toward making stolen bearer material less reusable.

title: FreeIPA 4.13.4 addresses critical access-control flaws
note: Primary release material for fixes tied to a flaw chain that could allow an unauthenticated LDAP client to create attacker-controlled Kerberos credentials and reach administrative privilege.

title: New Okta innovations close governance blind spots and extend zero standing privilege
note: Vendor announcement worth tracking because it explicitly brings governance, privileged access and Permiso-backed identity threat detection into one identity-security platform story.

title: Detect and disrupt AI-themed attacks with Microsoft Defender
note: A concrete device-code-phishing and BEC case study showing how correlated identity, email and endpoint telemetry can disrupt post-authentication abuse.

title: Veradigm discloses data theft through compromised vendor API credentials
note: Primary filing identifying compromised vendor credentials as the access path used to download patient data and explaining that the credential was scoped to a limited API interface.

title: Dropbox accounts breached through Lenovo email verification flaw
note: Security reporting on an identity-linking failure where fraudulent Lenovo IDs could be trusted into existing Dropbox accounts without the victim's Dropbox password.

title: Update on Security at METR
note: Primary incident disclosure covering a fail-open authentication bug, API-key theft, SSH persistence and a separate campaign involving credential stuffing and OAuth token-grant attempts.

title: Security update: September 2026 incident report
note: Affected-party disclosure tracing unauthorized access to an exposed internal test server and build-related credentials that required rotation and token revocation.

title: How Privileged Can Your AI Become? More Than You Might Think
note: A useful practitioner framing of privilege as dynamic and contextual for agents that can call tools, discover paths and expand effective reach during execution.

title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026
note: Primary threat-intelligence reporting with identity-relevant cases including M365 token theft, stolen API credentials, account abuse and autonomous cyber operations.

title: Notification of Data Security Incident
note: Affected-party notice from an identity-verification provider investigating unauthorized access to customer information, relevant to downstream proofing and fraud risk.

title: Authorization in MCP 2026-07-28: Clarifying trust relationships for agentic systems
note: Architecture-focused treatment of trust relationships among users, hosts, agents, MCP servers, authorization servers and downstream resources; older, but durable enough to retain as a reference.
